controls.name: half amplitude
controls.interpretation: The time-domain comparator responds to a known level change; lower error does not establish better timbre or matched loudness.

controls.name: second harmonic equalizer
controls.interpretation: The spectral centroid responds to the deliberate equalizer change while the RMS comparison worsens. This is a sensitivity control, not an audio-improvement verdict.

limitations: No ComfyUI model was run, no browser WASM capture was made, and no blinded listener judged these files. FFmpeg equalizer gain is a filter setting, not a measured +6 dB change of the second partial.
